name: Sum inputs
info:
Subflow that can be used for totalizing
differint inputs. A use case can be if
you want to show the total of three
input phases.

# description

A typical input is linking three phases
of power to the input, all with its own
topic.

The inputs are cached, based on `msg.topic`
and are summed as output.

# configuration

The output _rate_ defaults to once per 5
seconds, but that can be changed in the _edit
panel_. Note that you cannot output faster
than the inputs get injected.

If you check the _Show only changed values_
checkbox, only values that are different than
the previous sum will be outputted.

The _expected_ is the number of inputs with different
topics that need to be seen before the node starts outputting data. If set to `0`, this field is ignored
and output is send on first input.

The _topic_ can be used to set the topic.

# cache

If you want to delete a value from the
cache, you can input a message
with the `msg.payload` set to `delete`
and the `msg.topic` send to the item
that you want to delete.
